name: benchpark
description: Use and contribute to Benchpark, a Spack+Ramble-based framework for specifying reproducible HPC benchmarks across multiple systems.

interface.shortDescription: Specify, build, run, and contribute reproducible HPC benchmarks with Benchpark.
interface.longDescription: Guide for using and contributing to Benchpark: running an existing benchmark on a registered system, adding a new benchmark (experiment.py + ramble application.py + spack package.py), and adding a new target system/cluster. Covers the Spack-build / Ramble-run workflow.
defaultPrompt: Help me add a new Benchpark benchmark.
